source: ERA5 (ECMWF) via the Open-Meteo archive, at one point inside each state

methods.spi: McKee et al. 1993; WMO-No. 1090 (2012): gamma per calendar month, 1991-2020; where a month has too little rain to fit (the dry season), the Gringorten plotting position on 1991-2020
methods.spei: Vicente-Serrano et al. 2010: log-logistic per calendar month on rain minus FAO-56 ET0, 1991-2020 (Gringorten plotting position where the fit fails)
